tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// maṅgal yab yum la gnang ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs// ༄༅// gcig tu gzhan la phan dgongs pas// skye dgu'i gnyen gcig nyid gyur cing*// 'gro na yangs pa'i gdugs gcig po// gcig tu shis mdzad bkra shis shog /tshogs gnyis dpal las byung gyur cing*// bden gnyis rnam par thugs chud nas// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa po// gnyis med gsung gi bkra shis shog /sku gsum dpal gyis gzi 'bar zhing*// theg pa gsum gyi lam bstan pas// srid gsum 'ching ba rnam 'grol ba// dus gsum gzigs pa'i bkra shis shog /yang dag shes pas srid zhi'i mthar son nas// brtse bas skye dgu sdug bsngal las grol ba'i// sgrol ma dge ma dpa' mo'i bkra shis kyis// rtag tu khyed ni dge bar 'gyur bar shog /maṅgal yab yum la'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
